errors.text_span: някои двойки стълбове са групирани заедно
errors.evidence: The description incorrectly states that pairs of bars are grouped. The chart is a stacked bar chart, where each year has a single bar composed of two stacked segments.
The description fails to mention the legend and does not link the different bar segments (solid gray and dotted white) to the categories they represent ('Внос' and 'Износ').
